fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `f:` / `format:` search filter accepted `:` and `=` operators but silently ignored any relational operator (`>=`, `>`, `<=`, `<`). The operator was never forwarded to `format_where`, so `f>=pd10` produced the same result as `f:pd10` (only season 10, not "season 10 and later").

## What changed

**`find/search.py`**
- `parse_criterion`: pass `operator.value()` to `format_where` (was passing only `term.value()`).
- `format_where`: updated signature to `(operator: str, term: str)`. Added a new branch: when the operator is `>=`, `>`, `<=`, or `<` *and* the term resolves to a specific PD season (not `ALL`), the function enumerates `seasons.SEASONS`, keeps the ones that satisfy the numeric comparison against the target season number, and collects `format_id`s for each matching season code. The existing `:` / `=` and `ALL` branches are unchanged.

**`find/find_test.py`**
- Added four assertions to the existing `test_past_seasons` functional test covering `f>=pds5`, `f<=pds1`, `f>pds1`, and `f<pds5`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed.
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit find` — 60 passed, 48 deselected. The new functional tests are marked `@pytest.mark.functional` and were not exercised (no live database with card-legality data was available in the cloud environment); they follow the same pattern as the existing `test_past_seasons` functional tests and are expected to pass against a real database.

Fixes #12233
fix.pr_title: Support >=, >, <=, < operators for PD season format filter (#12233)

The existing `:` and `=` cases keep current behavior. About 25-35 lines net added.
